Willkommen zu deiner ersten Online-Deutschunterrichtsstunde mit mir!

Welcome to your first online private lesson! 
I'm thrilled to help you begin your journey into the language world that you are pursuing! Whether you're learning for travel, work, or just for fun, we'll start from the very basics to build a strong foundation.

pro_course_detail.title: Sing Your Way to Fluent English 🎶🎸🎷🎺🎹
pro_course_detail.description:
Looking for a fun and effective way to improve your English? My online private lessons are designed to make learning both enjoyable and engaging by incorporating English-language songs into each class!

What to Expect:
Customized Song Selection: We’ll use popular English songs from different genres (based on your preference) to enhance your listening skills, vocabulary, and pronunciation. Songs are a great way to remember words and phrases, helping you learn without even realizing it!

Active Listening & Comprehension: You won’t just listen to music — we’ll dive deep into the lyrics, identifying new vocabulary, expressions, and grammatical structures. You’ll learn how native speakers use the language in real life.

Singing for Pronunciation: Whether you’re a fan of singing or not, using music to practice pronunciation is a fantastic way to get those tricky sounds right. Don't worry if you’re shy — this is all about improving your accent and fluency in a relaxed and safe environment.

Creative Activities: Lessons include exercises like lyric gap-filling, reordering verses, and discussions about song themes. We’ll also explore cultural references and idiomatic expressions that appear in music.

Personalized Feedback: Each session is tailored to your goals, whether you're working on speaking, writing, listening, or reading. You’ll receive specific feedback and resources to keep improving between lessons.

Flexible Scheduling: Classes are scheduled at your convenience. Whether you want regular weekly sessions or a flexible schedule, we'll work it out to suit your needs.

By learning through music, you’ll enjoy the language, develop a natural flow in English, and boost your confidence in no time! Let's make your English learning experience as fun and memorable as your favorite song!

Ready to start? Book a lesson today!

pro_course_detail.description:
Learn to write a clearer and more concise RESUME the AMERICAN WAY.  Like cover letters,  American resumes are "tightly" organized.  The best are no more than one page,  maximum two.  No one wants to pick up a four-page resume.  Remember, the sole reason for a resume is to get you an interview.  You don't have to tell your whole life story in a resume.  If it LANDS YOU an interview, then it has done its job.  And so have you.  In this course, you will learn:

1. How the  UNIVERSITY OR COMPANY WEBSITE CAN HELP YOU use 
     precise  language  in your resume.
2. How to organize your resume to SHOW OFF YOUR BEST ACHIEVEMENTS--not 
     ALL of them--in the most succinct way.
3. How not to be repetitive. 
4.  What words immediately TURN OFF interviewers and recruiters.
5. The difference between EMBELLISHING your education and skills--and lying 
     about them.
6. As with resumes, you'll learn how to write an effective COVER LETTER.
7. Need an essay for your college or job application?  We'll also work on these, as well as practice 
    the essay section for all the English-language tests--IELTS, TOEFL and others.

pro_course_detail.title: The Simple Outline for Writing in English
pro_course_detail.description:
Create an informal but very useful outline for any writing project in English: emails,  essays, articles, speeches, work memos and more . A good outline helps you remember all the thoughts you want to write. This is especially true when you write in English which has such a huge vocabulary.

And no one is going to see your outline except you.  So, you don't have to be neat, put it onto a specific format, or concentrate on spelling or grammar.  An outline will benefit you no matter what your English level -  from intermediate to proficient.

In this class you'll learn:
*How to get over the dread of doing an outline.
* Why an outline works a lot better then memorizing ideas and details.
*The difference between a informal and academic outline.
* The wonderful fact that you don't have to follow your outline to successfully write. You can change your mind about what to write - or you can change your outline.

We'll start right away on your outline.  First you'll pick your writing topic.  Next, you'll write down your thoughts about what you want to communicate in your writing.  If you can't think of anything to write about, I'll interview you to find out your interests.  We'll then turn your outline into to a real piece of writing that you can use.

Class Expectations:
1. Keep a flexible mind when writing an outline and be open to ideas from me,  your teacher.
2. At the same time, prepare to write independently after a couple of sessions.
3. Expect homework on writing outlines or changing outlines into the final writing project.
4. Ask questions!

I look forward to having you in my class.

teacher_info.introduction:
Hi!  I am an experienced University ESL instructor with more than seven years' experience teaching Chinese college students!  I specialize in helping students who are preparing to study abroad.I have experience with learners from many other countries as well.

I graduated from Western Connecticut State University where I earned a bachelor's degree in English. I really enjoyed learning all different methods for language instruction in a masters level ESL course. I also especially enjoyed studying Linguistics & Semantics and this helps me have insight into the challenges my students face as they study English.

I began my teaching career as a substitute grade school teacher but by chance worked for a summer helping new college students with study skills. I soon was working in the Tutoring Resource Center of Western Connecticut State University and in time worked almost exclusively with foreign students who needed language coaching for assignments and test prep. In 2008 I moved to Chengdu and accepted a full time position teaching English for Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. Here I had new opportunities to develop my skills as a teacher. Over the years I have come to appreciate how important it is for the student to enjoy language learning and incorporate the target language into everyday life. Having said that, I don't really favor any one particular language teaching method or strategy. Each student is different and has different learning needs and preferences. One of the great things about one on one tutoring is the flexibility to tailor the lessons to the students individual needs. pro_course_detail.title: Market Leader English
pro_course_detail.description:
I have a set of books for all levels that I share with my students called 'Market Leader'. Common topics are finance, management, marketing, sales, business meetings, business communication, making presentations, and business social interaction.

One of the best aspects of the books is that they set up 'role play' situations where the student and I must act out some roles in business interaction, negotiation, bargaining for a sale, etc. The book also has a lot of interesting discussion topics and business articles which give us a lot of material for discussion. Lastly there are 'live situation' listening samples from people in business which cover a wide range of the different English accents and non-native European accents in English.
